findings.description: No transactions fell within this alert's review window as the account had no recorded activity in that period.
findings.why_it_matters: An empty review window makes it difficult to assess the validity of the velocity anomaly alert without expanding the search timeframe.

findings.description: Background transactions outside the review window show standard commercial vendor payments and trade settlements such as TXN-12820 and TXN-12814.
findings.why_it_matters: Provides contextual account behavior prior to the review window, though they do not trigger the alert itself.

investigation_questions: Why was a velocity anomaly alert triggered when the review window contains no recorded activity?
Are there any alternate accounts or hidden channels linked to the customer that might display the anomalous velocity?

recommended_next_steps.step: Verify source of funds for the anomalous amount or surrounding activity.
Compare the flagged timeframe or nearest transactions to historical patterns.

report.narrative_summary: Case CASE-006 was generated as a velocity anomaly alert with a medium severity for customer Divya Pandey. Upon review, no transactions actually fell within the designated review window, indicating an empty activity period for that timeframe. Nearest historical transactions have been reviewed as background context, but further investigation is required to reconcile the alert trigger with the lack of recorded activity in the review window.
